summary: TIM S.A., the Brazilian telecom, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its monthly CVM Resolution 44/21 consolidated report on directors' and related parties' securities holdings for September 2026. No transaction occurred: share counts, including the roughly 67.76% controlling-shareholder block and smaller management and fiscal-council balances, are unchanged, with no purchases, sales, derivatives or prices reported. There is no board recommendation, advisor, premium or structural mechanism. This is an ordinary insider-holdings disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle arise.
